judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass SB 767, which gave Calvert County deputy sheriffs and correctional deputies the right to organize and bargain over wages and their share of health care premiums. A union is certified when a majority of deputies sign a petition, or wins a secret ballot if the Sheriff challenges it. Any extra money a contract needs still requires approval by the County Commissioners. The Maryland House of Delegates passed it 108-27 and it was signed into law as Chapter 132 of 2025.
